project.name: MeshBench
project.detail: ADR-0001: a licence for MeshBench itself has not been chosen. Until it is, no rights are granted beyond running this copy, and the release pipeline refuses to publish a tagged build.

forks.name: MeshBench/qemu
forks.detail: Fork of qemu-project/qemu, branch meshbench-sx1262. Adds an SX1262 LoRa radio device upstream does not have, so ESP32 firmware sees its chip. The emulator in this bundle is built from this fork; the fork repository is the source offer.

forks.name: MeshBench/tlib
forks.detail: Fork of antmicro/tlib (Renode's translation library), branch sevonpend-any-pending. SEVONPEND now wakes the core on any pended interrupt, not only a newly pended one - without this, published nRF52 firmware sleeps for ever.

forks.name: MeshBench/renode-infrastructure
forks.detail: Fork of renode/renode-infrastructure. The C# half of the SEVONPEND fix, matching the tlib change.

forks.name: MeshBench/renode
forks.detail: Fork of renode/renode, branch meshbench. A portable bundle build that carries its own .NET runtime, so nRF52 emulation needs nothing installed.

forks.name: MeshBench/meshcore-native
forks.detail: Builds meshcore-dev/MeshCore applications unmodified and adds the host variant and bridge that let them run as plain processes. MeshBench downloads these builds at runtime; they are not in this bundle. Its NOTICE is reproduced below.

bundled.name: .NET runtime
bundled.detail: Inside the Renode portable bundle, so nothing needs installing to emulate nRF52 boards.

bundled.name: Dear ImGui / cimgui
bundled.detail: The native half of the old workbench1, which still ships in this binary until it is removed.

bundled.name: wgpu-native
bundled.detail: The GPU library inside cogentcore/webgpu that computes terrain profiles.

bundled.name: Noto Color Emoji
bundled.detail: Bundled beside the binary so node names with emoji render on machines without the font.

runtime.name: MeshCore
runtime.detail: The firmware under test. Builds are downloaded from MeshBench/meshcore-native releases on first use and cached; MeshCore is never redistributed inside this bundle.

runtime.name: Board firmware images
runtime.detail: Published MeshCore releases and flasher.meshcore.io, fetched on first use and cached under ~/.cache/meshcoresim.
runtime.text: Downloaded on demand under MeshCore's own terms; see the MeshCore entry above.

runtime.name: Nordic SoftDevice
runtime.detail: Not ours and cannot be redistributed. Anyone running published nRF52 firmware supplies their own copy; MeshBench never downloads or ships it.
runtime.text: The SoftDevice is distributed by Nordic Semiconductor under its own licence agreement and is deliberately absent from MeshBench bundles and downloads.

data.name: OpenStreetMap
data.detail: Basemap data for the standard and CARTO styles.
data.text: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence. Tiles rendered from this data carry their provider's terms.

data.name: CARTO basemaps
data.detail: The light and dark basemap styles.
data.text: Basemap style and tiles (c) CARTO, map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.

data.name: Esri World Imagery
data.text: Imagery (c) Esri and its data partners: Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS user community.

data.name: Terrain Tiles on AWS
data.detail: Elevation for hillshade, link budgets and the cut-through profiles (Mapzen terrarium tiles).
data.text: Terrain Tiles from the AWS Open Data programme, produced by Mapzen; contains elevation data from SRTM (NASA), USGS 3DEP, ETOPO1 (NOAA) and other public sources.
